meta.title: Smiling Face
meta.description: Perhaps a hand reaching out at our darkest hour, perhaps a blade laying hidden under a kind smile.

units.rawText: You really are very tough, but... this is farewell.
units.displayText: You really are very tough, but... this is farewell.

spans.text: You really are very tough, but... this is farewell.

units.rawText: Clang!
units.displayText: Clang!

spans.text: Clang!

units.rawText: Uwah, what a scary shot.
units.displayText: Uwah, what a scary shot.

spans.text: Uwah, what a scary shot.

units.rawText: The silver shield that suddenly flew in from the side deflects the glowing arrow. Said arrow falls to the ground and loses its original golden radiance.
units.displayText: The silver shield that suddenly flew in from the side deflects the glowing arrow. Said arrow falls to the ground and loses its original golden radiance.

spans.text: The silver shield that suddenly flew in from the side deflects the glowing arrow. Said arrow falls to the ground and loses its original golden radiance.

units.rawText: ...Eucharist?!
units.displayText: ...Eucharist?!

spans.text: ...Eucharist?!

units.rawText: My oh my, what's with that look on your face, Big Sis Angelus? Are you unhappy to see me?
units.displayText: My oh my, what's with that look on your face, Big Sis Angelus? Are you unhappy to see me?

spans.text: My oh my, what's with that look on your face, Big Sis Angelus? Are you unhappy to see me?

units.rawText: ...What is the meaning of this?
units.displayText: ...What is the meaning of this?

spans.text: ...What is the meaning of this?

units.rawText: I saw you went to the Enigma Sector to carry out a mission. I couldn't bear to be alone, so I followed you here!
units.displayText: I saw you went to the Enigma Sector to carry out a mission. I couldn't bear to be alone, so I followed you here!

spans.text: I saw you went to the Enigma Sector to carry out a mission. I couldn't bear to be alone, so I followed you here!

units.rawText: I didn't have any ill - in - ten - tions, you know!
units.displayText: I didn't have any ill - in - ten - tions, you know!

spans.text: I didn't have any ill - in - ten - tions, you know!

units.rawText: Oh, really now? Then why are you standing between me and them?
units.displayText: Oh, really now? Then why are you standing between me and them?

spans.text: Oh, really now? Then why are you standing between me and them?

units.rawText: Are you going to betray the Sanctifiers?
units.displayText: Are you going to betray the Sanctifiers?

spans.text: Are you going to betray the Sanctifiers?

units.rawText: Uwah, I wouldn't dare! Lord Eosphorous would censure us if we did, right?
units.displayText: Uwah, I wouldn't dare! Lord Eosphorous would censure us if we did, right?

spans.text: Uwah, I wouldn't dare! Lord Eosphorous would censure us if we did, right?

units.rawText: Still, I'm a little reluctant to see you wipe them out just like that, Big Sis.
units.displayText: Still, I'm a little reluctant to see you wipe them out just like that, Big Sis.

spans.text: Still, I'm a little reluctant to see you wipe them out just like that, Big Sis.

units.rawText: Eucharist! Do you know these are Irregular Agents you are sheltering?!
units.displayText: Eucharist! Do you know these are Irregular Agents you are sheltering?!

spans.text: Eucharist! Do you know these are Irregular Agents you are sheltering?!

units.rawText: Oh, I know that, but the matter here is more serious.
units.displayText: Oh, I know that, but the matter here is more serious.

spans.text: Oh, I know that, but the matter here is more serious.

units.rawText: To cut a long story short, you know what's going on in the Enigma Sector too, right? Otherwise you wouldn't have asked me to provide operand support to those Lesser Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: To cut a long story short, you know what's going on in the Enigma Sector too, right? Otherwise you wouldn't have asked me to provide operand support to those Lesser Sanctifiers.

spans.text: To cut a long story short, you know what's going on in the Enigma Sector too, right? Otherwise you wouldn't have asked me to provide operand support to those Lesser Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: The quantum computer here — "ENIAC" — has gone out of control and created an operand black hole.
units.displayText: The quantum computer here — "ENIAC" — has gone out of control and created an operand black hole.

spans.text: The quantum computer here — "ENIAC" — has gone out of control and created an operand black hole.

units.rawText: At this rate, all of Magrasea might end up being affected by it.
units.displayText: At this rate, all of Magrasea might end up being affected by it.

spans.text: At this rate, all of Magrasea might end up being affected by it.

units.rawText: That's true~ But are you going to cleanse her, Big Sis Angelus?
units.displayText: That's true~ But are you going to cleanse her, Big Sis Angelus?

spans.text: That's true~ But are you going to cleanse her, Big Sis Angelus?

units.rawText: Of course. Losing control of your operands is an "irregularity".
units.displayText: Of course. Losing control of your operands is an "irregularity".

spans.text: Of course. Losing control of your operands is an "irregularity".

units.rawText: But look at what's happened to the Enigma Sector. There must be, what, half a sector's worth of operand in the young Miss Eniac's tummy, right?
units.displayText: But look at what's happened to the Enigma Sector. There must be, what, half a sector's worth of operand in the young Miss Eniac's tummy, right?

spans.text: But look at what's happened to the Enigma Sector. There must be, what, half a sector's worth of operand in the young Miss Eniac's tummy, right?

units.rawText: If you destroy her, all that operand will go out of control in an instant, with a "Bang"...
units.displayText: If you destroy her, all that operand will go out of control in an instant, with a "Bang"...

spans.text: If you destroy her, all that operand will go out of control in an instant, with a "Bang"...

units.rawText:
Perhaps it might even blow the

 <size=40>whole</size>
 <size=48>sector</size>
 <size=56>up.</size>
 </color>

units.rawText: I know all that. But Eucharist... What does this have to do with the Irregular Agents you're defending?
units.displayText: I know all that. But Eucharist... What does this have to do with the Irregular Agents you're defending?

spans.text: I know all that. But Eucharist... What does this have to do with the Irregular Agents you're defending?

units.rawText: Naughty girls who try to cover up the truth get spanked, you know? It's very painful.
units.displayText: Naughty girls who try to cover up the truth get spanked, you know? It's very painful.

spans.text: Naughty girls who try to cover up the truth get spanked, you know? It's very painful.

units.rawText: Aw, don't be in such a rush, I was just about to get to it!
units.displayText: Aw, don't be in such a rush, I was just about to get to it!

spans.text: Aw, don't be in such a rush, I was just about to get to it!

units.rawText: As you know, they've helped fix the situation in three sectors already, Big Sis Angelus. Perhaps they might be able to fix this place too.
units.displayText: As you know, they've helped fix the situation in three sectors already, Big Sis Angelus. Perhaps they might be able to fix this place too.

spans.text: As you know, they've helped fix the situation in three sectors already, Big Sis Angelus. Perhaps they might be able to fix this place too.

units.rawText: The sectors that have been changed by the Irregular Agents have joined their Oasis. How is this any different from losing the Enigma Sector?
units.displayText: The sectors that have been changed by the Irregular Agents have joined their Oasis. How is this any different from losing the Enigma Sector?

spans.text: The sectors that have been changed by the Irregular Agents have joined their Oasis. How is this any different from losing the Enigma Sector?

units.rawText: Does that mean you'd rather blow up the whole of Enigma Sector? Uwah— how scary.
units.displayText: Does that mean you'd rather blow up the whole of Enigma Sector? Uwah— how scary.

spans.text: Does that mean you'd rather blow up the whole of Enigma Sector? Uwah— how scary.

units.rawText: Of course I'd rather avoid that, if possible...
units.displayText: Of course I'd rather avoid that, if possible...

spans.text: Of course I'd rather avoid that, if possible...

units.rawText: But I can't trust these Irregular Agents. If they fail, it isn't just the Enigma Sector that will be reset.
units.displayText: But I can't trust these Irregular Agents. If they fail, it isn't just the Enigma Sector that will be reset.

spans.text: But I can't trust these Irregular Agents. If they fail, it isn't just the Enigma Sector that will be reset.

units.rawText: Now be a good girl and step aside, Eucharist.
units.displayText: Now be a good girl and step aside, Eucharist.

spans.text: Now be a good girl and step aside, Eucharist.

units.rawText: How vexing~ I don't want to go head to head with you either, Big Sis Angelus, but I don't want them to die either. What shall I do?
units.displayText: How vexing~ I don't want to go head to head with you either, Big Sis Angelus, but I don't want them to die either. What shall I do?

spans.text: How vexing~ I don't want to go head to head with you either, Big Sis Angelus, but I don't want them to die either. What shall I do?

units.rawText: ...Is this the attitude the Eosphorous Faction takes toward Irregular Agents?
units.displayText: ...Is this the attitude the Eosphorous Faction takes toward Irregular Agents?

spans.text: ...Is this the attitude the Eosphorous Faction takes toward Irregular Agents?

units.rawText: It seems I'll have to suggest that Lord Hesperus pass down some management experience to Lord Eosphorous.
units.displayText: It seems I'll have to suggest that Lord Hesperus pass down some management experience to Lord Eosphorous.

spans.text: It seems I'll have to suggest that Lord Hesperus pass down some management experience to Lord Eosphorous.

units.rawText: Management experience? Surely you don't think Lord Hesperus' "Extermination Plan" was very successful, do you?
units.displayText: Management experience? Surely you don't think Lord Hesperus' "Extermination Plan" was very successful, do you?

spans.text: Management experience? Surely you don't think Lord Hesperus' "Extermination Plan" was very successful, do you?

units.rawText: I hear that now, many sectors are hostile to the Sanctifiers because of that, all thanks to Lord Hesperus!
units.displayText: I hear that now, many sectors are hostile to the Sanctifiers because of that, all thanks to Lord Hesperus!

spans.text: I hear that now, many sectors are hostile to the Sanctifiers because of that, all thanks to Lord Hesperus!

units.rawText: Everything Lord Hesperus has done is right—
units.displayText: Everything Lord Hesperus has done is right—

spans.text: Everything Lord Hesperus has done is right—

units.rawText: Heheh, you're still so protective of Lord Hesperus after he cast you aside, your loyalty is so touching, Big Sis Angelus!
units.displayText: Heheh, you're still so protective of Lord Hesperus after he cast you aside, your loyalty is so touching, Big Sis Angelus!

spans.text: Heheh, you're still so protective of Lord Hesperus after he cast you aside, your loyalty is so touching, Big Sis Angelus!

units.rawText: ...I have no need to waste words on Sanctifiers who protect Irregular Agents.
units.displayText: ...I have no need to waste words on Sanctifiers who protect Irregular Agents.

spans.text: ...I have no need to waste words on Sanctifiers who protect Irregular Agents.

units.rawText: I will speak with Lord Eosphorous later about how to deal with you. Now move aside.
units.displayText: I will speak with Lord Eosphorous later about how to deal with you. Now move aside.

spans.text: I will speak with Lord Eosphorous later about how to deal with you. Now move aside.

units.rawText: Angelus pulls her bow taut and points the tip of her arrow at Eucharist. The faint smile that has been on her face all this time has vanished.
units.displayText: Angelus pulls her bow taut and points the tip of her arrow at Eucharist. The faint smile that has been on her face all this time has vanished.

spans.text: Angelus pulls her bow taut and points the tip of her arrow at Eucharist. The faint smile that has been on her face all this time has vanished.

units.rawText: Do you really think I'm a goody-two-shoes who'll do as I'm told, Big Sis Angelus?
units.displayText: Do you really think I'm a goody-two-shoes who'll do as I'm told, Big Sis Angelus?

spans.text: Do you really think I'm a goody-two-shoes who'll do as I'm told, Big Sis Angelus?

units.rawText: Eucharist waves her hand and the silver shield flies back into her grasp. She winks toward us. Just like in Helios, her mood is filled with innocence and playfulness.
units.displayText: Eucharist waves her hand and the silver shield flies back into her grasp. She winks toward us. Just like in Helios, her mood is filled with innocence and playfulness.

spans.text: Eucharist waves her hand and the silver shield flies back into her grasp. She winks toward us. Just like in Helios, her mood is filled with innocence and playfulness.

units.rawText: This is going to burn up lots of operands, so you'll need to pay with two... No, three bags of chocolate, okay?
units.displayText: This is going to burn up lots of operands, so you'll need to pay with two... No, three bags of chocolate, okay?

spans.text: This is going to burn up lots of operands, so you'll need to pay with two... No, three bags of chocolate, okay?
What are you up to?

options.rawText: You can have as much chocolate as you want if you save us!
options.displayText: You can have as much chocolate as you want if you save us!

spans.text: You can have as much chocolate as you want if you save us!
No problem.

units.rawText: Aw, I came all this way to save you and you actually doubt me? I'm hurt.
units.displayText: Aw, I came all this way to save you and you actually doubt me? I'm hurt.

spans.text: Aw, I came all this way to save you and you actually doubt me? I'm hurt.

units.rawText: Hehe, I'll hold you to that.
units.displayText: Hehe, I'll hold you to that.

spans.text: Hehe, I'll hold you to that.

units.rawText: If I'd known you'd agree so readily, I would have asked for more... still, never mind.
units.displayText: If I'd known you'd agree so readily, I would have asked for more... still, never mind.

spans.text: If I'd known you'd agree so readily, I would have asked for more... still, never mind.

units.rawText: Are you so determined to be my enemy, Eucharist?
units.displayText: Are you so determined to be my enemy, Eucharist?

spans.text: Are you so determined to be my enemy, Eucharist?

units.rawText: Try guessing this one, Big Sis Angelus. Do you think I can save them from you?
units.displayText: Try guessing this one, Big Sis Angelus. Do you think I can save them from you?

spans.text: Try guessing this one, Big Sis Angelus. Do you think I can save them from you?
